Dear Mura,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R3 312719454/07
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
5GZ58g
Problem Description
: Charging Issue on Outlet1
Troubleshooting
: We have analyzed the logs and found that there have been multiple instances where Outlet1 has faulted. In some cases, we observed that the cable check process was not done properly. Additionally, we noticed issues with the SECC communication, specifically 'SECC: no comm for 750ms "DC1",' which occurred not very frequent in the charger.
As of now, all outlets on the charger are available and ready for use.
Please let us know if the cable check issue is related to a particular EV, or if there are any differences. If possible, could you provide the EV manufacturer details?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0392209-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R3 312719454/07] Charging Issue on Outlet1 CRM:00643001117
additional_info.body:
Hi Mura,
Thanks for sharing the update. However, the SECC logs for the particular model are not available due to time constraints. If the charger is rebooting, the previous logs will not be retained. We have analyzed the logs for today and tomorrow on Outlet1, and there are no issues. If the particular EV model is causing the session to fail, it would be helpful if you could attempt the charging again and provide the date and time so we can fetch the SECC logs for deeper analysis.
Recently, we checked the charger in our backend, and it's healthy, with all outlets ready for charging. You can attempt charging with a Tesla model, and if the issue persists, please create a new ticket. We can proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
